title: Device Control type reverts to ZDC when all characters are deleted from the group name
description: When a group is a Z or ZD Device control and the user deletes all characters from the group name in the group list, the Device Control type incorrectly changes to ZDC instead of retaining its original type.
steps: Observe the group list with a group named 'Group 5' which has 'ZD' as its Device Control type.
Tap on the 'Group 5' row to edit the group name.
Delete all characters from the group name field.
Observe the Device Control type displayed below the group name input field.
actual: The Device Control type changes to 'ZDC' after all characters are deleted from the group name.
expected: The Device Control type should remain as 'ZD' (or its original type) even after deleting all characters from the group name.
